say:1:1330224001:1.text: Finally, a customer! Just pick anything that catches your eye!
say:1:1330224001:1.source_cn: 喊了这么久终于有客人啦！你看上了那顶花环随便挑！
say:1:1330224001:1.male: Finally, a customer! Just pick anything that catches your eye!
say:1:1330224001:1.female: Finally, a customer! Just pick anything that catches your eye!

say:2:1330224002:1.text: This year is weird. My floral wreaths used to sell like hotcakes, you know?
say:2:1330224002:1.source_cn: 今年真奇怪，我记得以前祭典时蓝绒花花环明明很好卖的。
say:2:1330224002:1.male: This year is weird. My floral wreaths used to sell like hotcakes, you know?
say:2:1330224002:1.female: This year is weird. My floral wreaths used to sell like hotcakes, you know?

say:3:1330224003:1.text: But this time, I've barely sold any after so long...
say:3:1330224003:1.source_cn: 可是今年喊了这么久也没卖出几顶……
say:3:1330224003:1.male: But this time, I've barely sold any after so long...
say:3:1330224003:1.female: But this time, I've barely sold any after so long...
